name: base
purpose: default parameters (10 ps grid). vin changes before the first capture; a capture of 0.8 V at phase 0.32 of the 1 ns leak period, held 30 periods while sample stays high for 10 ns and vin steps twice under it; a negative capture (-0.6 V) that leaks toward 0 V from below; a capture 72.5 ps after a leak instant and one 52.5 ps before the next instant, so the leak acts on it after 52.5 ps; a 0.525 ns rst pulse that clears a nonzero value at phase 0.17, 0.83 ns before the next leak instant; a reset that spans a rising sample crossing and is released while sample is still high, with vin at -0.3 V there; two later captures and long holds.

name: phase-grid
purpose: default parameters (10 ps grid). Ten captures whose crossings lie at phases 0.07, 0.17, ..., 0.87 and 0.95 of the 1 ns leak period (72.5 ps after and 52.5 ps before a leak instant at the ends), each followed by a hold of two to four leak periods, with alternating signs; then two captures 1.05 ns apart (0.525 ns high, 0.525 ns low between them) and a final 11 ns hold. A model that restarts the leak grid at each capture, leaks continuously, or leaks only while sample is low is wrong on most of them.

name: reset-release
purpose: default parameters (10 ps grid). rst is high at t = 0 and a rising sample crossing passes in reset (vin 0.65 V); after the release the value stays 0 V until a capture; a 0.525 ns rst pulse between two leak instants that clears 0.68 V and covers no leak instant and no sample crossing; a double reset whose second rising crossing finds 0 V; a reset that rises while sample is high and is released 2 ns before sample falls, so no capture happens at the release; a reset held to the end with two sample pulses in it.

name: param-override
purpose: vth 0.2 V, decay 0.9, leak_period 10 ns (the longest legal period), tr 100 ps (2 ps grid). Control edges last 180 ps, so a 0.45 V threshold acts 50 ps late on rising edges. A capture at phase 0.30 of the 10 ns period held over two 10 % leak steps, a negative capture 57.5 ps before a leak instant, two captures inside one leak period, a rst pulse that clears a nonzero value, a capture 72.5 ps after a leak instant, and a final hold over three leak steps.
